articles.title: MacBook Neo, HP Professional 14, Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3: Which Laptop Is Lightest & Lasts Longest?
articles.description: If you carry your laptop to college or the office every day, weight and battery life matter as much as the processor. Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026, which began on October 8 and has no announced end date, lists laptops from Rs 30,490 to Rs 92,390 with very different weights and battery sizes. Here is a guide to reading the numbers, with the figures we could confirm. Watt-Hours Tell You More Than Hours Manufacturers quote battery life in hours, but the figure depends on the test, such as video playback or light web use. The battery's capacity in watt-hours, or Wh, is a more reliable way to compare laptops, because a bigger number means more stored energy. A laptop with a 60Wh battery should last longer than a similar one with 41Wh, if the processor and screen are comparable. Heavy tasks, bright screens and high refresh rates drain batteries faster, so treat claims such as "up to 16 hours" as the best case. Weight And Battery Compared Figures below come from Amazon listings summarised on October 8 and prices may have changed. Apple MacBook Neo 13-inch: 1.2kg, 36.48Wh battery, listed for up to 16 hours; Rs 68,990 in Amazon's announcement, though one October 8 check showed Rs 77,990. HP Professional 14 (2026): 1.4kg, 41Wh battery; Rs 92,390. Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3: 1.59kg, 50Wh battery, about 9 hours; Rs 75,990. Primebook 2 Max: 1.61kg, 60.3Wh battery, listed for up to 12 hours; Rs 30,490. It runs Android-based PrimeOS, so Windows software will not run on it. Samsung Galaxy Book4: 54Wh battery with about a 90-minute charge time; Rs 69,349. Dell 15 SmartChoice: 41Wh battery; Rs 76,990. ASUS Vivobook 16 (2026): 1.88kg, 42Wh battery; Rs 88,990. Weights for the Dell and Samsung models were not clear in the summaries we checked, so check the listing. What The Table Tells You The MacBook Neo is the lightest at 1.2kg and quotes the longest hours, but its battery is among the smallest in Wh, which shows how efficient chips can stretch a small battery, though results vary with use. The Primebook 2 Max has the largest battery, but it runs a different operating system. Among Windows laptops, the Samsung Galaxy Book4 and Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 have larger batteries than the Dell and HP, while the ASUS Vivobook 16 is the heaviest of those with listed weights because of its larger screen. If you walk a lot with your laptop, a lighter body can matter more than a slightly bigger battery. Charging And Ports Check whether the laptop charges over USB-C, because it lets you use one charger for your phone and laptop. The HP Professional 14 supports USB-C with Power Delivery, and the MacBook Neo has two USB-C ports, while the Samsung Galaxy Book4 offers HDMI, USB-A, USB-C and a LAN port, which saves carrying dongles. Fast charging also matters: Samsung lists a roughly 90-minute full charge on the Galaxy Book4. Check the charger's weight too, since it adds to your bag. Check The Offer Before You Pay Amazon has confirmed a 10 per cent instant discount on eligible SBI credit and debit cards, with caps and minimum order values. Listed MRPs on laptops can be very high, so compare the final payable amount, the warranty and the return window. You can browse laptops on Amazon and explore more laptop deals before you decide.

articles.title: Loop Capital cuts AAPL target to $330 over complicated 2026-2027 iPhone cycle
articles.description: Loop Capital downgraded its projections for Apple stock and cut its price target to $330 over iPhone shipments it doesn't expect the company to recover. Apple's staggered release schedule complicates that forecast. Apple Stocks Analyst Ananda Baruah lowered Apple's rating from Buy to Hold and cut its price target from $370 to $330. Loop initially attributed lower production plans to memory and processor shortages. Loop initially expected Apple to recover many of the lost shipments in 2027, but supply chain checks that the firm performed changed that outlook. The firm now believes Apple won't replace the 13 million iPhone shipments removed from its second-half 2026 plans. It estimates that Apple reduced planned iPhone shipments for the September and December quarters by roughly 10%, but how it comes to that number isn't clear. It now expects 79 million shipments in the December quarter, compared with Wall Street's overall estimate of 85 million. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums
